描述_EN: a ding was a ritual vessel used in ancient china to contain food during rites for the ancestors. in ancient china all bronze ritual vessels had a specific name. this tripod is called a 'ding'. these vessels became a collector’s item because of inscriptions cast on their surfaces, in scripts that were no longer in daily use.
描述_ZN: 鼎是古代中国的一种礼器，在祭祀祖先时用来装食物。 在古代中国，所有的青铜礼器都有一个特定的名称。 这个鼎被称为 "鼎"。 这些器皿成为收藏家的物品，因为在它们的表面铸有铭文，而这些铭文已不再是日常使用的文字。
